senses.gloss: m. sing. a. pl. (contr. of בן נאים, v. נָאֶה) one of becoming conduct, refined, a cultured person; opp. בּוֹר; (cmp.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 114a:7">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> top, as to a scholar’s duty to pay attention to dress). [For oth. opin., v. Sachs Beitr. II, 199; Frankel Monatsschr. 1846, p. 855.] <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:6">Mikv. IX, 6</cite>; Sabb. l. c. <he>של ב׳ וכ׳</he> the garments of a Bannaïm, if stained with pitch on one side cannot be immersed for levitical purposes before the stain is removed (because their owner is more fastidious).

<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:1">Tosef. Mikv. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:14">VII</cite>), 14 (where <he>גדולה</he> a. <cite ref="S00797"><he>קטנה</he></cite> refer to the stain; as to correct vers. v. R. S. to Mikv. l. c.). Sabb. l. c. <he>מאי ב׳</he> what does B. mean? Answer: <he>אלו וכ׳</he> it means the scholars who are engaged in building up the world (of civilization) all their lives (as if fr. <cite ref="B00942"><he>בָּנָה</he></cite>). Ib. (dresses of the B.) <he>אלו כלים וכ׳</he> are the court-garments imported &c., v. <cite ref="A00684"><he>אוֹלָרִין</he></cite>.
